purpose: Optimize the supplied red-team Hunyuan soldier as a Unity character mesh for IRONFRONT's 8v8 game
appearance_target: Keep the supplied red soldier's recognizable helmet, black visor, salmon-red armor accents, chest armor, pouches, backpack, gloves, knee pads, boots, tan-gray uniform and complete human silhouette; the result must read well from front, side, back and three-quarter views.
primary_quality_difficulty: Preserving the red shoulder, knee and helmet accents and the armored silhouette when reducing a densely fragmented Hunyuan source mesh.
technical_scope: Static low-poly LOD meshes with preserved UVs/textures; approximately 1.8 m grounded height; editable Blender source and GLB/FBX exports; fresh-import and multiview visual checks.
excluded_from_this_pass: Final skinning, animation, weapon grip and Unity runtime replacement

technical_check_definitions.lod_triangle_counts: Measure exported triangles for each LOD; LOD0 should be near 12,000-20,000 triangles and lower LODs progressively smaller without losing the human silhouette.
technical_check_definitions.scale_and_orientation: Confirm approximately 1.8 m total height, grounded feet, and documented facing axis after import.
technical_check_definitions.uv_material_survival: Confirm the exported mesh has UVs and the expected base-color, normal and metallic/roughness texture connections.
technical_check_definitions.fresh_export_import: Load the generated GLB and FBX in a clean Blender process and inspect geometry, scale and material assignments.
technical_check_definitions.visual_preservation: Open front, side, back and three-quarter previews of the generated LOD0 and inspect against the source's distinctive shapes and material readability.
